1477-2558-8347--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
1477-2558-8347--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Sela triggers. Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

728-3249-4474-5553.easyPrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-4474-5553.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

1011-2728-5256-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-5256-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-5256-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

4772-5660-6462-6753-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

141-2921-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

339-677-2292-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1350-3390-3518-5921-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

717-3365-4798-5686.description:
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Aeromoeba ability.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

252-2981-4871.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2511-3562-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Sky Hussar, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Sky Hussar from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

224-654-1772-5233.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Boros Garrison
Holding priority, activate Boros Garrison by tapping it, adding {R}{W}.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1247-3918-4306.description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1329-2178-3661-5686.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-3661-5686.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2440-4183-4720-4730.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy
2440-4183-4720-4730.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sparring Mummy with haste.
When the token Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sparring Mummy trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Sparring Mummy, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sparring Mummy for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Stonework Packbeast twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

1669-4050-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1228-2921-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a creature token this turn.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-2921-5470.description:
Create a creature token.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1129-3869-4067.notablePrerequisites: Harabaz Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four Allies.
1129-3869-4067.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Gretchen by tapping {2}{G}{U}, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat.

1690-2364-2538-3682.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mana Vault to your hand.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Mox Amber to your hand.
Repeat.
